title: StegVerse InTr Anthropic Transport Envelope
description: Hash-bound transport envelope for stegverse.intr.anthropic.transport.v1. Carries no credential material and confers no authority. Adapted from the Z.ai InTr envelope governance semantics; the wire representation is Anthropic-native and is not a duplicate of the Z.ai representation.

transport_id.description: Deterministic identity: 'svintr-anth-' + SHA-256 over the domain-separated canonical JSON of {protocol_version, transition_id, request_hash, ingress_receipt_hash, carrier_ref, endpoint_profile}.

request_hash.description: Exact hash of the normalized admitted StegVerse ProviderRequest. Recomputed locally and compared exactly.

ingress_receipt_hash.description: Exact lowercase SHA-256 of the external ingress ALLOW receipt.

carrier_ref.description: Mandatory TV/TVC carrier reference. A reference only — never credential material.
